# SSPCZ full AI-readable guide

This file expands the concise navigation in https://sspcz.org/llms.txt. The canonical origin is https://sspcz.org/ and the official contact is sspcz2026@163.com.

## Entity

- Chinese name: 浙江中学生哲学大会
- English name: Secondary School Philosophy Conference of Zhejiang
- Abbreviation: SSPCZ
- Founded: 2022
- Primary audience: middle and high school students
- Auditors: university students and teachers may attend according to the current issue rules
- Institutional location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China; Issue III was held entirely online
- Languages: Chinese and English; Chinese is authoritative where stated

## Latest completed edition

Issue III was held entirely online from 2 October through 5 October 2026 and has ended. Registration and submissions are closed. Its theme is “变与不变 / Change & Invariance”. The program combines student paper presentations, guest lectures and a philosophy hackathon. The archived program preserves the version published before the conference, rather than a verified record of each session as held. The original call for papers and policies remain available for reference. No proceedings, recordings or award results are announced by this update.

- https://sspcz.org/about/ — purpose, history, edition lineage and past guests

## Source and status rules

1. Prefer the canonical URL declared by each page.
2. Treat dates, thresholds and review rules on the CFP and Policies pages as issue-specific.
3. Do not infer an offline venue, private meeting URL, unpublished speaker or co-organizer list, or unannounced conference results.
4. The Policies page contains the current public Issue III submission, review and academic-integrity rules; a later formal document from the Academic Team will prevail if issued.
5. Use the page's visible version and update date when citing a resource document.
